doc_review.untrusted_warning: This file isn't in Blink's storage, so it can't be previewed or checked here. Only verify it if you've checked the original some other way.

owner_deletion_hint.pending: The owner asked to delete their Blink account, so this store can't be approved.
owner_deletion_hint.completed: The owner's Blink account was deleted, so this store can't be approved.

stores.degraded: This store's data is malformed, so only the basics are shown. Check it in the database before approving it.

filter_hint.pending: New stores and resubmissions waiting for a decision, oldest first.
filter_hint.documents: Live stores with a document Blink hasn't verified yet (new, or changed since it was checked), oldest first. Verify or reject each document.
filter_hint.rejected: Rejected or deactivated with a note. The merchant can fix and resubmit, or you can approve it directly.
filter_hint.live: Approved stores customers can see. Deactivating takes a store down and needs a note.

stores.documents_checked: Counted over the {checked} oldest of {total} live stores.

stages.stage1_desc: Account identity, owner details, and direct contact channels
stages.stage2_desc: Tax registry validation and commercial numbers
stages.stage3_desc: Store location, schedule, catalog items, and description
stages.stage4_title: Stage 4: Registre du Commerce (RC) & Official Scans
stages.stage4_desc: Official scanned filings, endorsements, and storefront photos

approve.title: Approve {name}?
approve.degraded: Some of this store's details couldn't be read, so its documents weren't checked. Approve anyway?
approve.verifies_shown: Approving also verifies the documents shown.
approve.verifies_all: Approving also marks all of its documents as verified.
approve.overrides_rejected: That includes the ones you rejected: {list}.

reject.title: Reject {name}
reject.note_placeholder: What needs fixing? e.g. The commercial register scan is blurry. Please upload a clear photo.
reject.note_hint: Required. They'll see this note in the app.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}
deactivate.note_placeholder: e.g. The store sells items that aren't allowed on Blink.
deactivate.note_hint: Required. They'll see this note in the app, and customers won't see the store anymore.

reject_doc.title: Reject {doc}
reject_doc.note_placeholder: What's wrong with it? e.g. The scan is blurry. Please upload a clear photo.
reject_doc.note_hint: Required. The merchant sees this reason in the app and can fix the document.

errors.note_required: Add a note so the merchant knows why.
errors.note_too_long: The note is too long (300 characters max).
errors.owner_leaving: The owner asked to delete their Blink account, so this store can't be approved. The list was refreshed.
errors.stale: This document changed since you loaded it. The list was refreshed, so check it again.
errors.document_missing: The merchant removed this document. The list was refreshed.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to review applications.
errors.not_found: This store no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
errors.conflict: This store changed or was already decided since you loaded it. The list was refreshed, so check it and try again.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

empty.stores_pending_desc: New merchant stores show up here before they go live.
empty.stores_documents_desc: When a live store uploads or changes a document, it shows up here until someone at Blink checks it.
empty.stores_rejected_desc: Stores you reject or deactivate with a note show up here until the merchant resubmits.

hint.pending: Riders who sent all four documents and are waiting for a decision, oldest first. Verify or reject each document.
hint.replacements: Approved riders who uploaded a new document. They stay approved while it waits for review, oldest first.
hint.rejected: Riders with a rejected document. They have to upload a new one, or you can verify it after all.

empty.pending_desc: Riders show up here once they have uploaded their licence and national ID.
empty.replacements_desc: When an approved rider replaces a document, it shows up here until someone at Blink checks it.
empty.rejected_desc: Riders with a rejected document show up here until they upload a new one.

hint.pending: Agents with a commercial register scan or a shop waiting for a decision, oldest first.
hint.rejected: Agents whose register scan or shop was rejected and who haven't fixed it yet.

empty.pending_desc: Agent registers and shops show up here before they are approved.
empty.rejected_desc: Rejected documents and shops show up here until the agent fixes them.

shop.reject_message: The agent is told the shop couldn't be verified and to check its details and documents. This can't carry a note.

reject_rider_doc.title: Reject {doc}
reject_rider_doc.note_placeholder: What's wrong with it? e.g. The photo is blurry. Please upload a clear one.
reject_rider_doc.note_hint: Required. The rider sees this note in the app and has to upload a new document. A rider who was approved goes offline.

reject_agent_doc.title: Reject {doc}
reject_agent_doc.note_placeholder: What's wrong with it? e.g. The scan is blurry. Please upload a clear photo.
reject_agent_doc.note_hint: Required. The agent sees this reason in the app and can fix the document.

done.rider_rejected: {doc} rejected for {name}. The rider was notified.
done.agent_rejected: {doc} rejected for {name}. The agent was notified.
